༄༅/ /bir srung thun mong ma yin pa'i nyams len bya tshul bar chad g.yul rgyal bzhugs so/ /༈/oṃ swa sti/grub brgya'i gtsug rgyan dpal ldan chos skyong

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// bir srung thun mong ma yin pa'i nyams len bya tshul bar chad g.yul rgyal bzhugs so// ༈ /oṃ swa sti/ grub brgya'i gtsug rgyan dpal ldan chos skyong dang*// gnyis min rigs kun khyab bdag drin can rjer// gus btud birwa'i thun min srung ba'i lam// zab mo'i ngag 'don mos ldan bskul ngor spel//

'dir gsung ngag rin po che lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i smin grol yongs rdzogs thob nas lam la slob par 'os pa'i gang zag gis srod dang tho rangs gang rigs su skyabs yul rnams gsal btab la/ bdag dang 'gro ba sogs kyi skyabs 'gro rgyas pa'am/ bsdu na/ bla ma mchog gsum yi dam lhar// gus pas skyabs gsol yid can rnams// byang chub thob par sems bskyed nas// 'khor mtsho'i dbyings las myur sgrol shog / ces dang*/ tshad med bzhi sogs sngon du btang nas/ swa bhā wa sa stong par bsam/ stong pa'i ngang las dur khrod chen po brgyad kyis bskor ba'i dbus su/ ri dwags kṛṣṇa sa ra'i pags pa'i gdan gyi steng du padma dang zla ba nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la rang skad cig gis rje btsun rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug birwa pa sku mdog dmar nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas sdigs mdzub gyen du bstan pa'i rtse mo cung zad bkug pas nyi ma mnan pa/ g.yon thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba thugs kar 'dzin pa/ rgyab tu dpag bsam gyi shing bzang po la sku rgyab bsten pa/ zhabs gnyis rgyal po rol pa'i 'dug stangs kyis bzhugs pa/ sku shin tu grims pa/ zhal dang spyan bgrad cing ljags 'dril ba/ rus pa'i rgyan drug gis brgyan cing me tog sna tshogs kyis thod bcings pa/ de'i rgyab tu dpag bsam gyi shing bzang po/ mdun du tri shu la gyen du bgrengs ba la ḍā ma ru dpyangs pa/ g.yas su bum pa bdud rtsis gang ba'i steng du thod pa bdud rtsis gang bas brgyan pa/ g.yon du rig ma mtshan nyid dang ldan pas gdugs 'dzin pa/ smin mtshams kyi thad kar srung 'khor gzhal yas khang dang bcas pa'i dbus su bcom ldan 'das kyai rdo rje lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor dang bcas pa/ rang gi lus kyi dbus su rtsa dbu ma chos bzhi ldan/ g.yas su ro ma/ g.yon du rkyang ma ste rtsa gsum bsam pa'i spyi bor ham̐/ mgrin par oṃ/ snying gar hūm̐/ lte bar am̐/

gsang gnas su hā rnams gsal bar gyur/ ces pa/ pho brang lnga yi lha gsal gdab/ dkyil 'khor lnga la btud de bskrun// ces pa'i don rnams so// de nas rlung kha sbyor du bya ba ni/ srog rtsol 'gog pa'i sbyor ba yis// zhes pa'i don te/ de nas rlung bum pa can bzung nas/ rang bzhin gyis gnas pa'i bshang sgo'i rlung gis lte ba'i me sbar/ g.yas ro ma'i nang nas zhugs/ 'khor lo rnams mas rim gyis gsal btab/ me de spyi bo'i ham̐ la reg pas/ de las byang chub kyi sems g.yon rkyang ma nas babs/ 'khor lo rnams yas rim gyis gsal btab pa'i mthar/ ro rkyang gnyis kyi rlung dang byang chub kyi sems rnams dbu ma'i mas sna nas zhugs te/ rlung sems thig le thams cad dbu mar thim par bsgoms la bum can thub tshad du bya ste/ 'bar g.yo brtan pa la brten nas// zhes pa'i don to// de ltar rlung sems dbu mar zhugs pas/ bde stong zung 'jug gi nyams skye bar 'gyur te/ bde chen chos sku'i nam mkha' mthong*// zhes pa'i don to// de ltar rlung sbyor mang du byas pa'i mthar/ lus kyi 'dug stangs kyang birwa pa bzhin bya ste/ lag pa g.yas pa sdigs mdzub byas pa'i rtse mo cung zad bkug la/ g.yon thod pa 'dzin tshul thugs kar khu tshur kha gyen bstan/ zhabs gnyis rgyal po rol pa'i 'dug stangs byas la/ ngag gis rlung lan gcig bus shing phyir mnan/ rang gi nad gdon sdig sgrib dang*// gsang spyod blta bar mi dbang ba'i// 'byung po mi dang mi min kun// rgya mtsho'i phar mthar bskrad par gyur// ces brjod la/ rlung mi thub pa dang nang du dal bus bsdus nas/ bum pa can 'dzin dus/ de phyir me ri rab 'bar bas// bar chad g.yul las rgyal bar 'gyur// zhes brjod la/ gong bzhin rlung bus shing phyir mnan/ nyon shes sdig sgrib bag chags kun// ma lus byang zhing dag par gyur// zhes brjod la/ rlung nang du bsdus nas bum pa can 'dzin dus/

rdo rje'i sa gzhi rwa drwa la// gur dang bla bre srung 'khor phyir// me dpung rab 'bar de dbus su// rang nyid rnal 'byor dbang phyug gyur// de nas srung ba gnyis bsgom pa'i dang po rdo rje rtse gsum gyis bsrung ba ni/ lag pa g.yon pa'i mthe bos mthe'u chung mnan la/ sor mo gzhan gsum brkyang pa dpral bar reg ste/ akṣe bhi ma/ khar reg la/ pa tshe u pa ma/ snying gar reg la/ shi pa la tha ra/ lte bar reg la/ ha u a tshe u/ liṅgar reg la/ wa pa/ zhes yas rim dang*/ yang liṅgar reg la/ birwa/ lte bar reg la/ pa/ snying gar reg la/ pra/ khar reg la/ sa dheṃ/ dpral bar reg la/ swā hā/ sngags 'di rnams rlung bzung ba'i bar du brjod cing*/ swā hā'i rjes la phyag rgya bkrol te/ g.yon pas se gol brdab/ gnyis pa rnal 'byor bsrung ba la/ lus kyi 'dug stangs 'phags pa ltar/ rkang pa gnyis kyi brang sa la btsugs/ rting pa gnyis 'phongs la gtad/ pus mo gnyis phyir dgyel/ lag pa gnyis rdo rje phyir bsdams pa las mthe bong gnyis/ gung mo gnyis/ mthe'u chung gnyis rnams rtse sprad pa'i phyag rgya bcas te/ rlung bum pa can gyi ngang nas sngags rnams yid kyis zlos shing*/ mthe bong gnyis snying gar reg la/ akṣe bhi ma/ gung mo gnyis khar reg la/ pa tshe u pa ma/ mthe'u chung gnyis lte bar reg la/ shi la pa tha ra/ gung mo gnyis liṅgar reg pa/ ha u a tshe u/ mthe'u chung gnyis bshang sgor reg la/ wa pa/ zhes yas rim dang*/ yang mthe'u chung gnyis slar bshang sgor reg la/ birwa/ gung mo gnyis liṅgar reg la/ pa/ mthe'u chung gnyis lte bar reg la/ pra/ mthe bong gnyis snying gar reg la/ sa dheṃ/ gung mo gnyis khar reg la/ swā hā/ zhes mas rim dang*/ yang gong bzhin snying ga nas bshang sgo'i bar phyag rgyas reg la/ akṣe bhi ma/ nas/ wa pa'i bar gyi sngags yid kyis zlos shing rlung btang la/ lag pa gnyis kyis se gol gtog par bya'o// de ltar rdzogs nas bir bstod rgyas bsdus gang rigs brjod/

dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /rnal 'byor dbang phyug 'grub gyur nas// sogs brjod/ ces bir srung thun mong ma yin pa'i nyams len nag 'gros 'di lta bu zhig dgos zhes ke la ngag blo nas lha rdzas bcas bskul ngor/ lha btsun mkhyen dbang pas dam pa'i gsung bzhin bris pa dge legs 'phel// //grub chen rnal 'byor kyi dbang phyug birwa pa la bstod pa seṅge'i sgra dbyangs zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༄// bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo// rgyal ba kun gyi ngo bo gcig gyur pa// phrin las bzhi yis rigs bzhi'i don mdzad cing*// 'jigs pa'i gzugs kyis bdud dpung skrag mdzad pa'i// dpal ldan bi rū pa la phyag 'tshal lo// phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i rdzu 'phrul gyis// sa yi khyon 'dir mi 'jigs seṅge'i sgra// rab tu bsgrags pas kun las rnam rgyal gyis// dpal chen bi rū pa la phyag 'tshal lo// 'chi bdag bcom nas 'chi med dngos grub brnyes// bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho rdzogs pa'i lto ba can// 'od stong 'bar ba'i nyin byed dbang po yang*// sdig mdzub stobs kyis gnon pa'i mthu dang ldan// grub brnyes dam pa gtsug gi nor bu yis// gus pas rab mchod seṅge'i rol pa'i gnas// thugs kyi dkyil 'khor nyi 'od lta bu yis// nags phyogs ku mud bzhin ras zum par mdzad// phyi rol mngon phyogs mchog tu 'dzin pa'i lha// rig pa tsam gyis rab tu 'gas mdzad cing*// 'gran zla bral ba'i grub chen mchog gyur ces// dad pa'i blo thob bstod dbyangs rgya cher sgrog /gsung gi 'od kyis ma rig mun bsal nas// 'gro ba thar pa'i lam du 'dren pa yi// dpag yas yon tan 'od kyi drwa ba can// gang la bstod tshig me tog snyem pas 'bul// dge ba gang thob de yis srid zhi la// mi gnas bla med go 'phang thob gyur cig / ces slar yang rong ston chen pos dpal nā lend+ra rnam par rgyal ba'i dgon par sbyar ba'o//
// ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
